name: io.github.christianclaudio/snowflake
title: mcp-server-snowflake
description: Enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Snowflake data cloud and Cortex AI.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake account identifier (e.g. xy12345.us-east-1). Optional if configured in connections.toml.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_USER
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake username. Optional if configured in connections.toml.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to RSA private key file (for JWT key-pair authentication)

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_RAW
environmentVariables.description: Raw PEM-encoded RSA private key string

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for encrypted RSA private key

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_AUTHENTICATOR
environmentVariables.description: Authenticator type (e.g. externalbrowser, oauth, snowflake_jwt, username_password_mfa)

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_CONNECTION_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Connection profile name defined in ~/.snowflake/connections.toml (e.g. 'default', 'trial', 'prod'). When set, loads account, user, authenticator, role, and warehouse from the profile.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: tools/list is unchanged and any tool not annotated readOnlyHint=true is refused at call time

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile: full (default, 140 tools), readonly (readOnlyHint=true tools only), a job profile (dba, pipeline, cortex, apps), or one domain name. Unknown values stop startup.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_MCP_ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to replace tools/list with search_tools and call_tool. Profile full only; mutually exclusive with SNOWFLAKE_MCP_ENABLE_CODE_MODE.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_MCP_TOOL_SEARCH_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Tool Search backend: regex (default) or bm25.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_MCP_ENABLE_CODE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for experimental Code Mode (search, get_schema, execute). Profile full only; needs fastmcp[code-mode], skipped with a warning otherwise.
